name: Sugset Ashwagandha Tea Powder 200g – Traditional Ayurvedic Blend for Daily Wellness
original_description:
### Sugset Ashwagandha Tea Powder – 200g | A Time-Honored Ayurvedic Herbal Infusion for Daily Rituals

Rooted in the quiet wisdom of Ayurveda, Sugset Ashwagandha Tea Powder is a pure, hand-harvested blend of Ashwagandha root — traditionally prepared and gently ground to preserve its natural character. Sourced from regions where herbal heritage runs deep, this unadulterated powder invites you to pause, breathe, and honor the simple beauty of herbal infusion.

In Ayurvedic tradition, Ashwagandha has long been valued for its earthy depth and calming presence. This tea powder captures that essence — offering a warm, grounding infusion that flows naturally into the rhythm of daily life. Whether enjoyed at dawn or dusk, it is a gentle companion to moments of stillness.

How to Prepare
Add 1 to 1.5 teaspoons of Sugset Ashwagandha Tea Powder to 1 cup of warm water. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes, strain, and sip slowly. Many find it harmonious when incorporated into morning or evening routines — adjusted to suit personal preference and pace.

No flavors. No preservatives. No additives.
Just 100% pure, plant-based Ashwagandha root — dried naturally, ground with care, and crafted to honor ancient methods of herbal preparation.

About Sugset
At Sugset, we believe in herbs not as solutions, but as silent allies to daily rhythm. Our Ashwagandha is ethically wild-harvested, air-dried under the open sky, and minimally processed — preserving its natural integrity. We honor the land, the labor, and the legacy behind every pinch of powder.

For those who resonate with Ayurvedic tradition, this is more than tea. It is a quiet practice — a moment of connection to nature, to time, and to self.
